an5.209:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassa.
an5.209:1.3: attanāpi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati, parepi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti, gahapatikāpi ujjhāyanti:
an5.209:1.4: ‘yatheva mayaṃ gāyāma, evameva ime samaṇā sakkiyaputtiyā gāyantī’ti, sarakuttimpi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati.
an5.209:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassāti.
